slices.focus: Miriam revises Tasha's role description to formally include bereavement operations and reporting
slices.summary: At the start of 2026, Miriam revises Tasha's role description to formally include bereavement operations improvement, volunteer coordination support, and monthly referral reporting. Tasha feels validated but wary — the broader language means she could become the designated landing pad for every broken process. The agent helps her plan a one-page scope document with four headings (own, support, depend on others for, monthly reporting), a conversation with Miriam asking for specific support structure rather than vague reassurance, and success criteria to prevent being measured by 'endless availability.' The key reframe: 'recognition becoming boundaries.'
